title: Terms of Service
intro: These Terms govern your use of the Green Media app and website (the "Services"). By creating an account or using the Services you agree to them.

sections.heading: 1. The Services
paragraphs: Tools to manage your business's Google Business Profile, Facebook and Instagram: review replies, AI posts, Google posts and photos, keyword planning and reports. Features depend on your plan.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
paragraphs: Keep your phone and sign-in secure; you're responsible for activity on your account. Business information you give must be accurate, and you must be allowed to manage the business's online profiles.

sections.heading: 3. Approval of content
paragraphs: AI drafts are suggestions. You review and approve what is published (or choose automatic posting where offered) and are responsible for published content. We may decline content that breaks these Terms or Google's or Meta's policies.

sections.heading: 4. Your content
paragraphs: You keep ownership of your photos, text and data, and let us use them only to provide the Services (for example to post them on your profiles).

sections.heading: 5. Plans and payment
paragraphs: Prices are in Indian Rupees and shown before you pay. Plans are one-time payments for the period shown and don't renew automatically. Refunds follow the Refund Policy in the app.

sections.heading: 6. Acceptable use
paragraphs: Don't use the Services for fake reviews, spam, misleading or unlawful content, to access others' accounts, or to disrupt the Services.

sections.heading: 7. Third-party services
paragraphs: Google, Meta and Razorpay have their own terms. Changes or outages on their side can affect features.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimer
paragraphs: The Services are provided "as is". We work to grow your visibility but don't guarantee specific rankings, views, calls or sales.

sections.heading: 9. Liability
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, and we aren't liable for indirect or consequential loss.

sections.heading: 10. Ending
paragraphs: You can stop using the Services and delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that break these Terms.

sections.heading: 11. Law
paragraphs: Indian law applies; courts at Pune, Maharashtra, India have jurisdiction.
